interfaces.name: RawSensorSample
interfaces.purpose: Immutable Android/external sample
interfaces.units: accelerometer m/s^2; gyro rad/s; magnetic uT
interfaces.nullability: Optional channels nullable; mandatory value width exact
interfaces.validation_rules: Finite values; known sensor; unique evidence ID; arrival >=0
interfaces.error_behaviour: Record and reject from scientific input
interfaces.replay_behaviour: Replay exact values/order; preserve original clock ID

interfaces.name: LocationGnssFix
interfaces.purpose: One provenance-preserving location-family observation
interfaces.coordinate_frame: WGS84/geodetic; adapter converts to session NED
interfaces.sequence_semantics: Per provider stream; evidence consumed once
interfaces.nullability: Altitude/speed/bearing and accuracies nullable by mask
interfaces.validation_rules: Range, age, provider, finite covariance floors
interfaces.replay_behaviour: May be hidden from estimator while retained as reference

interfaces.name: ImuBatch
interfaces.purpose: Bounded ordered core/model input
interfaces.coordinate_frame: Physical IMU body b; never vehicle-aligned for S2 propagation
interfaces.nullability: No missing mandatory accel/gyro pair semantics are fabricated
interfaces.validation_rules: 1e-6<=dt<=0.20 s for S2; gaps flagged
interfaces.error_behaviour: Invalid sample excluded with evidence reason

interfaces.name: SensorQualityStatus
interfaces.purpose: Availability, timing, delivery and resource health
interfaces.validation_rules: No inferred measurements from unavailable APIs
interfaces.replay_behaviour: Replay recorded status; derived status versioned

interfaces.name: CalibrationPrior
interfaces.purpose: Prior/evidence for initialization; not operational bias owner
interfaces.validation_rules: Finite symmetric PSD covariance; validity gate
interfaces.replay_behaviour: Deterministically recomputed or replayed with provenance

interfaces.name: AlignmentEstimate
interfaces.purpose: Phone body to vehicle transform posterior outside S2
interfaces.sequence_semantics: Latest valid posterior; no hidden overwrite
interfaces.validation_rules: Unit quaternion w>=0; covariance PSD; status gate

interfaces.name: NavigationState
interfaces.purpose: Canonical scientific nominal state
interfaces.nullability: No nullable physical state when valid
interfaces.validation_rules: Finite; quaternion normalized/canonical; origin match
interfaces.error_behaviour: Publish invalid fault; never display as valid

interfaces.name: NavigationUncertainty
interfaces.purpose: 15-state covariance tied exactly to I-07
interfaces.units: mixed squared SI per S2 ordering
interfaces.validation_rules: Symmetric finite; PSD defect surfaced; no clipping

interfaces.name: LearnedCorrectionProposal
interfaces.purpose: Optional bounded pseudo-measurement proposal
interfaces.validation_rules: Physical bounds, finite PSD covariance, model/window match

interfaces.name: ConstraintDecision
interfaces.purpose: Accept/reject record for learned or map proposal
interfaces.validation_rules: Eligibility, duplicate and state-epoch checks
interfaces.replay_behaviour: Reproduce decision or mark policy comparison

interfaces.name: MapMatchResult
interfaces.purpose: Top-K hypotheses and abstention without state overwrite
interfaces.coordinate_frame: graph WGS84 geometry; projected session NED
interfaces.validation_rules: Version/origin match; probabilities conditional; no CLEAR on negative gates

interfaces.name: CanonicalGnssMeasurement
interfaces.purpose: S2 position/velocity measurement after one-family adaptation
interfaces.sequence_semantics: Evidence ID consumed on first presentation
interfaces.nullability: Velocity may be absent; kind declares dimension
interfaces.validation_rules: S2 dimensions; positive-definite innovation covariance; origin/time exact
interfaces.replay_behaviour: May be masked while original I-02 retained

interfaces.name: IntegrityStatus
interfaces.purpose: Separated sensor/GNSS/navigation/model/map/recording health axes
interfaces.validation_rules: Allowed enum transitions and reason codes
interfaces.error_behaviour: Surface degraded/failed; no coercion to healthy

interfaces.name: OutageEvent
interfaces.purpose: Declared natural/quality/software-simulated GNSS invisibility interval
interfaces.validation_rules: Software mask affects estimator only; raw/reference retained

interfaces.name: ReacquisitionEvent
interfaces.purpose: Returning-fix candidate/decision/dwell/recovery evidence
interfaces.validation_rules: No first-fix privilege; evidence unique; policy transition valid
interfaces.replay_behaviour: Exact replay or versioned policy comparison

interfaces.name: UiNavigationSnapshot
interfaces.purpose: Read-only scientific plus separately marked display/map/reference presentation
interfaces.validation_rules: Scientific state immutable; labels mandatory by mode
interfaces.error_behaviour: Show stale/fault/unavailable; no fake valid trace

interfaces.name: ReplayControlEvent
interfaces.purpose: Demo control separated from scientific input
interfaces.clock_domain: replay control clock; target session clock
interfaces.validation_rules: No LIVE source mutation; seek resets run identity

interfaces.name: SessionManifest
interfaces.purpose: Complete/incomplete recording identity and ordered file hashes
interfaces.validation_rules: Every file hash/size; no absolute paths; completeness explicit
interfaces.replay_behaviour: Replay only after verification; incomplete diagnostic-only

interfaces.name: ModelManifest
interfaces.purpose: Model, normalization, data, export, runtime and rights identity
interfaces.validation_rules: Hash/schema/golden vectors/runtime/op whitelist/rights gate

interfaces.name: DatasetManifest
interfaces.purpose: Private dataset/subset/split/leakage and rights contract
interfaces.validation_rules: Hashes, no overlap, duplicate parent grouping, runtime/label firewall

interfaces.name: MapGraphManifest
interfaces.purpose: Shared PBF, graph, display, region, build and licence lineage
interfaces.validation_rules: All hashes/version match; attribution; no final route unless field approved

interfaces.name: ConfigurationBundle
interfaces.purpose: Immutable feature flags, thresholds and identities
interfaces.nullability: No implicit defaults for safety gates
interfaces.validation_rules: Schema/range/cross-field validation
interfaces.error_behaviour: Reject start or disable affected optional feature
